test_migration_up: test the MigrationAddTtlToQueueLock.up() method adds a ttl field to existing lock documents in the queue locks collection
test_migration_down: test the MigrationAddTtlToQueueLock.down() method removes the ttl field from all lock documents in the queue locks collection
test_migration_validate: test the MigrationAddTtlToQueueLock.validate() method ensures a sample of lock documents have the ttl field present
test_migration_full_cycle: test the MigrationAddTtlToQueueLock migration up and down cycle preserves correct ttl values for existing and new lock entries
test_assert_ttl_helper: test the assert_ttl helper function verifies ttl field presence and value for a given lock key in the queue locks collection
